title: Returning yet another
text:
Returning yet another. I originally gave this 5 stars. In 4 months time the vacuum stopped performing properly. I do not overly use this
weekly and it's just my husband myself and our dog now that the kids are grown. I was so disappointed in it's loss of suction and it claims to never loose suction. The warranty ran out but Amazon honored it for me. That's why I love buying from amazon they are truly fair with their honest customers. I no longer can give this product 5 stars. Sorry to say it's on the way back to the manufacturer for a full refund. I am purchasing a Dyson since I have tried all the vacuums out there and NOT one can stand up to my standards. I just like clean floors and carpets and I do not like to waste my time going over and over the same spot a zillion times to get it to pick up. I do not recommend this product. Also the on board attachments are very poor in pick up. There is very weak suction.
